title: The black-screen watchdog (pixel strikes, rebuild, reload)
oneLine: Samples the world canvas every 5 s; first-join one strike, play two strikes rebuild, four strikes reload.
topConcern: A sample asked before a renderer rebuild is collected after it from the old detached canvas, charging a false dark strike.

title: The door: boot phase, auto-join and the address's door words
oneLine: bootPhase checking/login/create/null, the auto-join latch and URL door words route a page to door, creator or world.
topConcern: Creator ENTER runs joinTown twice (handler, then auto-join effect); DeviceScreen's Login Key reload drops ?guest=1 and the page's switches.

title: The straight-in road: resume snapshot, recovery reload and its cap
oneLine: bt_resume snapshot, bt_resume_now/spot and a 2-per-5-minute reload cap carry a tab back into the world after a reload.
topConcern: Typing another character's key clears only bt_rpg/bt_stats, so the reload replays the previous character's snapshot into the look stores.

title: The loading gate: is the world on screen, and its held messages
oneLine: worldIn, up, readyAt and a 24-deep held list decide when world messages may show after a loading screen.
topConcern: On ?debug=1 markWorldIn is never called, so every banner and toast is held forever; an older __introLiftedAt gate coexists.

title: The onboarding referee: one tutorial voice at a time, and Skip tutorial
oneLine: Module flags pace the welcome plate, coach cards and install card; Skip tutorial silences them per browser.
topConcern: QuestCoach's retire path hides a showing card without noteCoach(false), leaving _coachUp true so the install card never shows until reload.

title: The banner slots: quest plate queue, level-up, collect and achievement toasts
oneLine: React message slots with timed expiry and a 3-deep quest-plate queue promoted by the 500 ms interval.
topConcern: questMsgRef updates only on render, so two queued notices in one tick both see the old slot and the second stomps the first.

title: The move broadcast gate (rest packet, keepalive, quiet phone, shield and gear edges)
oneLine: Ten send-now triggers and a dozen last-sent stamps decide when this player's move, gather_node and track relays go.
topConcern: Facing marked sent by the outer gate even when no move went (no channel, quiet-held); healed by the next keepalive.

title: The idle clock: away flag and the client's own idle logout
oneLine: One input timestamp drives the aw flag and a 2-minute client hang-up backed by the worker's packet sweep.

title: Holding the shield: per-frame guard window and the computer's right-button toggle
oneLine: 250 ms rolling shieldEnd, mouse/lock steering and the right-click toggle around shieldToggle's raise/drop.
topConcern: BLOCK_COSTS_STAMINA is a hand-mirrored client/worker switch; a phone's toggled guard survives the page going away.

title: Touch input arbitration: left stick, right zone, the disc, and letting go
oneLine: Three touch surfaces with finger ids, tap/drag/flick classifiers and shared attack flags, released when the page goes away.
topConcern: touchcancel runs the same handlers as touchend, so a system-cancelled touch can forward a click, cycle weapons, open chat or cast a special.

title: Tap-to-lock and the computer's press/click pairing
oneLine: S.lockedTarget tap writers (promote, toggle, double click, duel/NML/party/spar branches) plus press-to-click dedupe stamps.
topConcern: Canvas onTouchEnd keeps its own monster hit test with no player branch, and its 600 ms stamp swallows any following click.

title: The weapon in hand: active slot, the session latch, and the swap preview
oneLine: rpg.activeSlot mirrored with the worker; after any swap a session latch makes the phone ignore the worker's slot.
topConcern: The worker's own repair to melee when the active bow/staff is unequipped never reaches a latched phone, which keeps an empty slot.

title: Warps onto the farm: hand-written zone entries beside the zone machine
oneLine: Four copied blocks write currentZone='farm_home' with their own clear lists instead of the zone machine's.
topConcern: None of the farm warps calls clearZoneLocalFx, so campfire, in-flight light, extraction and peer projectiles survive the trip.

title: Lighting a fire: the in-flight light and the client-only campfire
oneLine: A 700 ms lighting phase then a 45 s zone-stamped client campfire; the log is paid on the worker.
topConcern: A refused firemaking_request still plays out and lights a usable local campfire; only the log comes back.

title: The arena's background poll and the page's own bet payout
oneLine: An HTTP poll latches involvement and the current match; legacy page bet payouts only without caps.sponsor.
topConcern: Out-of-order poll answers can re-set _arenaMatch, which steers the quiet phone's move cadence until the next poll.

title: Timed effects on the HUD: worker buff timers mirrored, page's own on old workers
oneLine: Absolute buff end-times from the worker drive chips and client math against the phone's own clock.
topConcern: No clock-skew correction (unlike farmBus serverNow and dailyRewards _skew): a wrong phone clock shows or drops buffs the worker still applies.

title: The 500 ms mirror of the loop's surroundings into React
oneLine: Copies near door/hall/shut door/clan invite/dungeon mouth/farm spots and the player list into React state.

title: Door and prompt buttons that act on touchstart AND on the click behind it
oneLine: Workshop, Pet House and Wheel dungeon prompts bind both onTouchStart and onClick (TRAPS §131).
topConcern: Dungeon Workshop opens on touchstart; the emulated click then lands on its .bt-inspect backdrop and closes it, geometry permitting.

title: The building card and the one-panel rule (shop drawer, bottom sheet)
oneLine: buildingPanel modal slot; effects close Diego's drawer when any panel or the sheet opens.

title: Rare windows' code, fetched on first open (lazyPanel)
oneLine: Per-window module loader: shared promise, one cache-busting retry, a Couldn't-open card with Reload and Close.

title: Eating from the bag: the predicted bite and the fight's one-bite cooldown
oneLine: Predicted consume and heal plus a client copy of the worker's in-fight bite cooldown, corrected by refusals.

title: Resting: Sleep button and E, the worker's rest, and the page's old one
oneLine: With caps.rest the bed and Hotel ask the worker; the page-side restore and bed-tile sleep bar are legacy.
topConcern: Old-worker branch and bed-tile sleep restore bars on the page; unreachable now (caps.rest true, no tile 15 on the farm).

title: The tour prompt and the teach-by-doing step banner
oneLine: Old seven-step tutorial banner and its opt-in prompt; hard-off since v2.3.1593.
topConcern: Dormant copy describes the retired map and step 4 fires at once in the Wheel; harmless while off.

title: Old lands' zone actions, the endgame portal and the death-scatter timer
oneLine: Raft, torch, sled, snow and Dark Sanctum/Light Summit portal on closed old lands; legacy death-scatter countdown.
topConcern: Wood spent and zones warped on the page with no worker message, only on retired paths; portal buttons are touchstart-only.

title: Saving the page's own stats
oneLine: bt_stats written only when changed on the 500 ms tick, bt_update_stats every 600 ticks.

title: The loading screen's way in: showIntro, body.bt-intro-up and its three gates
oneLine: joinTown arms the clip with asset, server and Wheel-arrival gates; IntroVideo lifts it and clears the body mark.
topConcern: joinTown throwing after marking the body sends the page to the door with bt-intro-up left on until a veil self-heal.
